ui.f_story: The watch was born when people wanted to carry time with them. Today, your rhythm fits in your pocket too.
ui.letter_lead: Write to the person you'll be in 90 days. What you hope for them, what you don't want them to forget.
ui.dip_quote: A missed day erases nothing. Ninety days of coming back, even less so.
ui.dip_witness: Witnessed by the sundial, the calendar, the mechanical clock and the watch.
